# Amrize Announces Date for Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results


October 14, 2026[Download as PDF](https://investors.amrize.com/_assets/_3ea0470e4568468a3823cfd87fe4e27e/amrize/news/2026-10-14_Amrize_Announces_Date_for_Third_Quarter_2026_140.pdf)


CHICAGO & ZUG, Switzerland--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Amrize (AMRZ) will release its third quarter 2026 financial results after the U.S. market closes on Wednesday, October 28, 2026, followed by a live webcast to discuss the company’s financial results at 7:30 am Central Time on Thursday, October 29, 2026.


Registration for the live webcast can be completed at[https://amrize-quarterly-results-q3-2026.open-exchange.net/](https://amrize-quarterly-results-q3-2026.open-exchange.net/)


Amrize’s financial results, presentation materials and webcast will be accessible in the events section of[www.amrize.com/investors](http://www.amrize.com/investors) . A replay and transcript will be available at the same location following the webcast.


**About Amrize**


Amrize (NYSE: AMRZ) is building North America, as the partner of choice for professional builders with advanced branded solutions from foundation to rooftop. With over 1,000 sites and a highly efficient distribution network, we deliver for our customers in every U.S. state and Canadian province. Our 19,000 teammates uniquely serve every construction market from infrastructure, commercial and residential to new build, repair and refurbishment. Amrize achieved $11.8 billion in revenue in 2025 and is listed on the New York Stock Exchange and the SIX Swiss Exchange. We are ready to build your ambition.


Learn more at[www.amrize.com](http://www.amrize.com/)
